items.question: Can I choose where I want to go?
items.answer: Yes. You can indicate province preferences when applying.

items.question: Do you place in both public and private facilities?
Are rural placements mandatory?
items.answer: No. You choose the environments you’re open to.

items.question: Can I move between provinces after a placement?
items.answer: Yes. Many allied professionals explore long-term opportunities across different provinces.

blocks.html: Goodwill Staffing connects nurses with permanent roles in provinces across Canada. From city hospitals to remote communities, we offer support, guidance, and relocation coordination assistance.
